findings.title: Token Validation Vulnerability
findings.description:
🔐 Empty token accepted - Authentication token validation is weak or missing

• Vulnerability: Empty token accepted
• Endpoint: GET /account-consents/{consent_id}
• Impact: Potential unauthorized access through token manipulation
findings.remediation:
✅ IMPROVE TOKEN VALIDATION:

1. STRICT TOKEN VALIDATION
   • Reject empty, malformed, or invalid tokens
   • Validate token signature and expiration

2. SECURE TOKEN HANDLING
   • Never accept tokens in URL parameters
   • Use Authorization header exclusively
   • Implement proper token revocation

3. DEFENSE IN DEPTH
   • Log authentication attempts
   • Monitor for suspicious token usage
   • Regular security testing of authentication flows

🔐 Token accepted in URL parameters - Authentication token validation is weak or missing

• Vulnerability: Token accepted in URL parameters
• Endpoint: POST /account-consents/request
• Impact: Potential unauthorized access through token manipulation
findings.remediation:
✅ IMPROVE TOKEN VALIDATION:

1. STRICT TOKEN VALIDATION
   • Reject empty, malformed, or invalid tokens
   • Validate token signature and expiration

2. SECURE TOKEN HANDLING
   • Never accept tokens in URL parameters
   • Use Authorization header exclusively
   • Implement proper token revocation

3. DEFENSE IN DEPTH
   • Log authentication attempts
   • Monitor for suspicious token usage
   • Regular security testing of authentication flows

1. IMPLEMENT AUTHENTICATION MIDDLEWARE
   • Validate authentication tokens on every request
   • Return 401 Unauthorized for missing/invalid tokens

2. ENFORCE ACCESS CONTROL
   • Apply authentication consistently across all endpoints
   • Use framework-level security controls

3. SECURE BY DEFAULT
   • Assume all endpoints require authentication unless explicitly public
   • Conduct regular security reviews of authentication logic

findings.description:

• Протестировано 3 метода обхода рейт-лимитов:
  1. Быстрые последовательные запросы (15 запросов с интервалом 50ms)
  2. Ротация User-Agent заголовков (25 различных агентов)
  3. Спуфинг IP-адреса через X-Forwarded-For и другие заголовки
• Всего выполнено запросов: 25
• Тестируемый эндпоинт: POST /auth/bank-token

📊 РЕЗУЛЬТАТ:
Система корректно ограничивает количество запросов и защищена от базовых методов обхода.
findings.remediation:

• Рейт-лимитинг корректно работает на публичных эндпоинтах
• Система устойчива к базовым методам обхода (User-Agent rotation, IP spoofing)
